name: mecatl-studio
description: Mecatl Studio: the browser UI and its backend for frontend, built on the published @stacklok-oss/mecatl-sdk

scripts.check: biome check . && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm generated:check
scripts.generate: pnpm --filter @mecatl-studio/server run generate:openapi && pnpm --filter @mecatl-studio/contracts run generate
scripts.generated:check: pnpm generate && git diff --exit-code -- contracts/openapi.json contracts/src/generated
